hooks.command: jq -e '(.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.relative_path // .tool_input.paths_include_glob // "") | test("\\.(rs|py|gd|cpp|cc|hpp|h)$")' >/dev/null && { echo "Code files: symbol tools only (replace_symbol_body / insert_*_symbol / rename_symbol / safe_delete_symbol; new files: create_text_file)." >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0

jq -e '(.tool_input.command // "") | test("(^|[;&|(`]|\\$\\()\\s*(\\S*/)?(python[0-9.]*|uv|uvx|pip[0-9]*)(\\s|$)|[Bb]lender\\S*\\s[^;&|]*--python")' >/dev/null && { echo "Direct python/uv/pip/Blender-python runs are off (owner 2026-09-07): go through make targets (make test-assets TESTS=<path>, make census, make assets); inspections become census tools with TOML output." >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0
